metadata.description: Skills for AI coding assistants: continue a dead session from its transcript, and scout reusable foundations before building.

plugins.name: continue-work
plugins.description: Continue a dead session in a fresh one. Reads the old session's transcript from disk, checks it against the files and any checkpoint, and carries on without you restating anything.

plugins.name: reuse-scout
plugins.description: Before building, search GitHub, registries and the web for existing foundations. Returns the closest bases to fork or extend, plus the gaps that still need custom work.
